    # Full separator rows/columns are the grid lines.

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Encoded colors lie at the intersections of regularly spaced
    # horizontal and vertical bands. Detect the band locations by their
    # greater-than-background variation.
    def intersections(horizontal):
        n = h if horizontal else w
        m = w if horizontal else h
        scores = []
        for i in range(n):
            line = grid[i] if horizontal else [grid[r][i] for r in range(h)]
            scores.append(len(set(line)) > 1)
        found = [i for i, x in enumerate(scores) if x]
        if len(found) < 2:
            return []
        # The marked bands have a consistent pitch; retain that cadence.
        gaps = [b-a for a, b in zip(found, found[1:])]
        from collections import Counter
        step = Counter(gaps).most_common(1)[0][0]
        start = found[0]
        return [i for i in found if (i-start) % step == 0]

    rr = intersections(True)
    cc = intersections(False)

    # Select the marked crossings, omitting the outermost bottom/right
    # boundary bands. The crossings themselves are the output pixels.
    if not rr or not cc:
        return grid
    rr = rr[:-1]
    cc = cc[:-1]
    out = [[grid[r][c] for c in cc] for r in rr]

    # Remove empty outer columns/rows that are merely grid framing.
    while out and all(v == grid[0][0] for v in out[-1]):
        out.pop()
    if out:
        width = max((i+1 for i in range(len(out[0]))
                     if any(row[i] != grid[0][0] for row in out)), default=len(out[0]))
        out = [row[:width] for row in out]
    return out if out else [[grid[0][0]]]
